_note: Every ability/keyword the app can show, keyed by id. Entries flagged needsVerification:true are edition-core rules seeded as scaffolding — diff their wording against your 11th-ed source and drop the flag once checked. Delete this _note key whenever you like; the loader ignores keys starting with an underscore.

grab-dat-scrap.name: Grab Dat Scrap
grab-dat-scrap.description: While this unit is engaged, this unit has +1 OC.

totem-of-mork.name: Totem of Mork (Psychic)
totem-of-mork.description: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.description:
Each time an attack is made with a [PSYCHIC] weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's BS or WS characteristic and any or all modifiers to the hit roll.

Attacks made with [PSYCHIC] weapons are known as psychic attacks (this can be important for the triggering of other rules).

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon's attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).

smash-em-up.name: Smash 'Em Up
smash-em-up.description:
In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, this unit's melee attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

indiscriminate-detonations.name: Indiscriminate Detonations
indiscriminate-detonations.description:
In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

grot-infestation.name: Grot Infestation (Once per battle per unit)
grot-infestation.description:
When this unit is destroyed, you can use this ability. If you do:
• Place this unit in strategic reserves with all of this unit's destroyed models returned to it. This unit is no longer destroyed.
This unit has Deep Strike.

close-quarters.name: Close-quarters
close-quarters.description:
Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using close-quarters shooting (10.06).

When using another shooting type, for each model in that unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with:
• One or more of its [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons.
• One or more of its other ranged weapons.

waaagh.name: Waaagh!
waaagh.description:
You can re-roll advance rolls made for friendly ORKS units.

Once per battle, at the start of the Command phase, you can call a Waaagh!. If you do, until the end of the next turn, the Waaagh! is called for friendly ORKS units. While a Waaagh! is called for a unit, it can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.
waaagh._call_note: These three keys drive the always-on call button at the bottom of the screen. Remove them and the button disappears — it is entirely data-driven.
waaagh.callWhen: Start of the Command phase · once per battle
waaagh.callDuration: Until the end of the next turn
waaagh.callEffect: Friendly ORKS units can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance move.
waaagh._callGif_note: Optional background flourish played when the button is pressed. Drop the file at this path; if it is missing or fails to load, nothing happens and the button behaves exactly as before. Remove this key to switch the flourish off.

lethal-hits.name: Lethal Hits
lethal-hits.description: Each Critical Hit scored with this weapon automatically wounds the target.

sustained-hits.name: Sustained Hits
sustained-hits.description: Each Critical Hit scored with this weapon scores a number of additional hits on the target, as specified by the ability (e.g. Sustained Hits 1).

devastating-wounds.name: Devastating Wounds
devastating-wounds.description:
Each time an attack made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon results in a critical wound, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the D characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks.

Mortal wounds inflicted by [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each critical wound; any remaining mortal wounds inflicted by that attack are lost.

Example: An attack made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon with a D characteristic of 3 results in a critical wound against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 mortal wounds. The first 2 mortal wounds are sufficient to destroy 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining mortal wound is lost.

rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid-fire.description:
This ability always takes the form [RAPID FIRE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step.

Example: If a [RAPID FIRE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).

assault.name: Assault
assault.description: This weapon can be shot by a unit that Advanced this turn.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.description: Add 1 to Hit rolls with this weapon if the bearer's unit Remained Stationary this turn.

pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.description: This weapon can be shot even when the bearer's unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, but it can then only target one of those enemy units.

blast.name: Blast
blast.description:
Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).

If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], each time you gather attack dice for such a weapon, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead.

Example: If a [BLAST 2] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: Attacks made with this weapon automatically hit the target.

precision.name: Precision
precision.description: While resolving attacks made with one or more [PRECISION] weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step (05.03), if the target unit contains one or more CHARACTER models visible to one or more of the attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group that contains one of those visible CHARACTER models. If they do, until those attacks are resolved, or until that CHARACTER group is destroyed (whichever happens first), that CHARACTER group is the current allocation group.

ignores-cover.name: Ignores Cover
ignores-cover.description: The target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against attacks made with this weapon.

hazardous.name: Hazardous
hazardous.description: Each time a unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of hazard rolls (06.03) for that unit equal to the number of [HAZARDOUS] weapons you selected in the Select Weapons step.

melta.name: Melta
melta.description: Add the specified value to this weapon's Damage characteristic when it targets a unit within half range (e.g. Melta 2).

lance.name: Lance
lance.description: Add 1 to Wound rolls with this weapon if the bearer's unit made a Charge move this turn.

twin-linked.name: Twin-linked
twin-linked.description: Re-roll the Wound roll for attacks made with this weapon.

extra-attacks.name: Extra Attacks
extra-attacks.description: Attacks with this weapon are made in addition to the attacks made with the bearer's other melee weapon.

anti.name: Anti-
anti.description: Wound rolls of the specified value or better against the specified target keyword are Critical Wounds (e.g. Anti-Vehicle 4+).

indirect-fire.name: Indirect Fire
indirect-fire.description: This weapon can target units that are not visible to the bearer, with penalties to the Hit roll and the target gaining the Benefit of Cover.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: During the Declare Battle Formations step, this Character can be attached to one of the units it is able to lead, forming an Attached unit.

deep-strike.name: Deep Strike
deep-strike.description: During Deployment, this unit can be set up in Reserves instead of on the battlefield, and can arrive from Strategic Reserves more than 9" from enemy models.

scouts.name: Scouts
scouts.description: This unit can make a Normal move of up to the specified distance before the first turn begins (e.g. Scouts 6").

infiltrators.name: Infiltrators
infiltrators.description: During Deployment, this unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from the enemy deployment zone and any enemy models.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: Subtract 1 from Hit rolls for ranged attacks that target this unit.

lone-operative.name: Lone Operative
lone-operative.description: This unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12".

fights-first.name: Fights First
fights-first.description: This unit fights in the Fights First step of the Fight phase.

feel-no-pain-4.name: Feel No Pain 4+
feel-no-pain-4.description: Each time this model suffers damage, roll one D6: on a 4+ that damage is ignored.

feel-no-pain-5.name: Feel No Pain 5+
feel-no-pain-5.description: Each time this model suffers damage, roll one D6: on a 5+ that damage is ignored.

feel-no-pain-6.name: Feel No Pain 6+
feel-no-pain-6.description: Each time this model suffers damage, roll one D6: on a 6+ that damage is ignored.

deadly-demise.name: Deadly Demise
deadly-demise.description: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6 each unit within 6" suffers the specified number of mortal wounds (e.g. Deadly Demise D3).

firing-deck.name: Firing Deck
firing-deck.description: Each time this Transport shoots, it can also fire the ranged weapons of the specified number of models embarked within it (e.g. Firing Deck 6).
